2.1 At the request and specific instructions of the CLIENT, DULSCO shall provide the Services as set out in Schedule I of this Agreement (“Services”) (hereinafter referred to as the “Personnel”). The Personnel provided by DULSCO to the CLIENT will always remain under the complete control and supervision of the CLIENT and DULSCO shall not interfere with the work of the Personnel while they are deputed to the CLIENT. DULSCO shall not be responsible for any direct or indirect acts of the Personnel until the time they are at the CLIENT site and working under the direct supervision of the CLIENT.
2.2 All visa applications are subject to government approvals and DULSCO shall not be responsible for any rejections by the relevant authorities.

2.3 Under the terms of this Agreement, DULSCO shall at all times act as an independent contractor. This Agreement does not in any way create a relationship of principal and an agent between CLIENT, and DULSCO shall not act or attempt or represent itself as an agent of CLIENT.

4.1 In consideration of the Services to be rendered, the CLIENT will pay DULSCO a service fee, as set out, in Schedule I to this Agreement (“Service Fees”).
4.2 The Parties agree that two (2) months prior to the expiry of the Term, the parties shall discuss and mutually agree that the Service Fees shall be reviewed.
5.1 The payment conditions under this Agreement shall be as follows:

p.li: In consideration for DULSCO performing the Services under the provisions of this Agreement, DULSCO shall invoice the CLIENT monthly in relation to the Service Fee.
The CLIENT shall make payment of the invoice within thirty (30) Days from the date of the invoice.
Invoices shall be paid by the CLIENT either by cheque or by wire transfer to DULSCO’s designated bank account.

ol.p: 5.2 Any overdue payments by the CLIENT shall attract a penal interest @ 2% per month.

DULSCO shall require its Personnel to execute an undertaking with respect to this confidentiality provision.
8.1 It is clearly agreed and understood by the Parties hereto that DULSCO’s responsibility hereunder is limited to its obligations as defined in Schedule I of this Agreement.

8.2 DULSCO shall not be liable for any damages caused or implied as a result of the direct and indirect actions of the Personnel while performing duties for the CLIENT; including any third party losses or claims (to the extent not covered by insurance) or any claim for loss of profits or consequential loss or any loss due to willful negligence, misconduct or fraud.

8.3 The CLIENT hereby agrees to indemnify and hold DULSCO harmless from any liability arising from any and all claims, requests, debts, expenses, losses and actions instituted by the Personnel arising out of their secondment to the CLIENT by DULSCO including but not limited to any claims or requests that the Personnel makes to the Ministry of Labour/Courts in the State of Qatar. The CLIENT shall make sure that the working environment at its premises does not compromise the health/safety of the Personnel and that all Applicable Law at its premises is complied with. CLIENT will fully indemnify DULSCO for any breach thereof.

8.4 Notwithstanding anything to the contrary to any other clause in this Agreement; the maximum liability of DULSCO under or arising out of and/or in relation to this Agreement is limited to 5% of the total monthly fees paid for the specific Personnel individually and up-to a maximum of QAR 5,000 (QAR Five Thousand) in aggregate for all liabilities under or arising out of and/or in relation to this agreement. DULSCO shall have no liability of whatsoever nature under or arising out of and/or in relation to this Agreement unless all of the fees due to DULSCO have been received in full by DULSCO. DULSCO shall have no liability in respect of any claim unless notice of the claim is given to DULSCO specifying the matters giving rise to the claim within three (3) Business Days of such matters being known to the CLIENT. No claims shall be made against any director, employee or sub-contractor of DULSCO individually.

8.5 Neither Party shall, in any event, be liable for any indirect or speculative or consequential or penal damages, including, but not limited to, any loss of use, loss of data, business interruptions, and loss of income or profits, irrespective of whether it had an advance notice of the possibility of any such damages. Neither Party shall also be liable for any third party claims.
9.1 Either Party may terminate this Agreement for convenience by giving a written advance notice of thirty (30) days to the other Party.
9.2 Either Party may terminate this Agreement for a remediable breach if such breach has not been cured within thirty (30) days of a written notice by the aggrieved Party.

9.3 If the CLIENT wants to withdraw or terminate any Personnel after the expiry of the probation period of the Personnel; it must give a written advance notice equivalent to the notice period of the Personnel as set out in the specific employment contract of such Personnel or equivalent billing in lieu thereof.

9.4 Termination of this Agreement shall not entitle either Party to set off any outstanding payments due to each other as on date of termination. Any such payment due to one Party shall be cleared in full by the other within thirty (30) days of termination.

9.5 DULSCO shall, upon receipt of any notice of termination, proceed in an orderly, rapid and economic way with the procedures to terminate its Services under this Agreement. The CLIENT shall proceed to pay all dues and claims that have accrued till the last day of rendering of Services by DULSCO, after the notice of termination.
9.6 The CLIENT shall also ensure that upon termination, all documentation (and copies thereof) shall be delivered to DULSCO immediately.
9.7 DULSCO may terminate this Agreement at any time and without the need for any prior written termination notice upon the occurrence of any of the following events:

p.li: Any change on ownership or management of the CLIENT; and/or
Acquisition or attainment of a controlling influence over the business of the CLIENT by a third party; and/or
The CLIENT attaining either directly or indirectly an interest in a company competing with the business of DULSCO; and/or

The CLIENT is declared bankrupt, makes an assignment for the benefit of creditors, appoints or suffers the appointment of a receiver or trustee over its property and/or files a petition for insolvency.

ol.p: The CLIENT shall specify the duties of the Personnel in writing to DULSCO. The CLIENT or DULSCO will inform each other of any acts of misconduct or inability or failure to provide the services by the Personnel and discuss the action /steps to be taken. The CLIENT shall be responsible for taking all necessary measures and/or legal actions against the Personnel in breach, in consultation with DULSCO.

p.b: 10.2 Sourcing of Candidate (only if recruitment service is agreed):

p.li: The CLIENT will provide accurate job descriptions and its operation information so that DULSCO is able to source accurate profiles matching to those job descriptions;
The CLIENT will provide timely and adequate access to resources to interview candidates proposed by DULSCO;
The CLIENT will give timely and accurate feedback within twenty four (24) hours to DULSCO to enable faster closing of the positions.

ol.p: The CLIENT warrants and undertakes that it shall comply with the local and federal rules and Applicable Law in relation to health and safety requirements, working hours, overtime and all requirements and specifications. The CLIENT shall not assign work of a hazardous nature (with particular reference to health and safety risks) without prior written approval of DULSCO and in any event, notwithstanding such approval, only where there is provision of adequate work and personal safety and protection equipment and training.

The CLIENT shall intimate the locations in writing as to where the Personnel shall be deputed. The Personnel shall be deputed only at CLIENT’s assigned premises to perform activities related to CLIENT’S products or services. The CLIENT shall be solely responsible for costs and consequences including penalties, fines, damages etc. arising out of any action initiated by any regulatory authorities if the Personnel are found working at any third party premises. Should the CLIENT wish to relocate the Personnel, the CLIENT shall send a written intimation to DULSCO no later than three (3) days prior to such requested relocation. The CLIENT shall provide a clear job description of the Personnel in the Schedule and any deviation from this job description shall be deemed to be variation of this Agreement and shall be mutually discussed and agreed in writing between the Parties.
The CLIENT shall not recruit or attempt to recruit any DULSCO Personnel.

The CLIENT shall maintain the attendance records of the Personnel and shall submit such records to DULSCO no later than three (3) Business Days prior to the end of the calendar month or at such frequency as mutually agreed between the Parties in order to enable DULSCO to process the salaries and benefits of the Personnel.

The CLIENT may request for a withdrawal of any of the Personnel in case of proven theft, fraud and/or immoral or unethical acts. The CLIENT shall fully intimate DULSCO of the actions of the Personnel along with any evidence substantiating such acts. In the event that DULSCO is fully satisfied that such an act has been committed, DULSCO shall withdraw the Personnel and a fee proportionate to the number of days worked by the Personnel shall be payable by the CLIENT to DULSCO. The CLIENT may, in any other case, request for the withdrawal of any of the Personnel subject to the payment of one (1) month’s Service Fees to DULSCO.
11.1 DULSCO shall bear the responsibility of paying salaries and benefits, to Personnel in time, provided the CLIENT pays as per the terms agreed and as per Applicable Law.

13.1 Any notice or other document to be served under this Agreement may be delivered or sent by commercial courier or facsimile to the Party to be served at its address set out in the preamble of this Agreement or in Schedule 1 or as otherwise agreed between the Parties.

13.2 When providing service of a notice or document it shall be deemed given in the case of commercial courier, when delivered as evidenced by delivery slip, and in the case of facsimile, upon proof of successful transmission.

13.3 In the event of notice being given after 4:00 pm on a regular Business Day, or on a day which is not a Business Day, the date of service shall be deemed to be the next Business Day. For purposes of this clause, “Business Day” means a day (other than a Friday and Saturday) on which banks are generally open in the State of Qatar for normal business operations.

14.6 Neither Party to this Agreement will be liable for breach of this Agreement to the extent caused by or arising from the following events, including but not limited to Acts of God, fires, floods, weather, or other catastrophes, epidemics or quarantine restrictions, storms, war (whether declared or not), civil strife, labor disputes, strike, lock-out or other labor problems, accidents, riots , shortage of materials, acts of Government authorities the prohibition or restriction by Applicable Law or regulation of any Government or any other matters whether or not of the same nature of the foregoing, which are beyond the control of the Party thereby affected and which could not have been reasonably foreseeable, and which are not caused by acts or omissions of the Party in breach and affected and that could not have been avoided and that have rendered the performance of this Agreement impossible (“Force Majeure Events”). Upon the occurrence of a Force Majeure Event preventing either Party from performing its respective obligations hereunder, the obligations of the affected Party which have been affected shall be suspended during the period affected by Force Majeure. The Party suffering such event will promptly notify the other Party in writing and if the period of suspension lasts for longer than thirty (30) Business Days, then the affected Party may decide at any time thereafter to terminate all or any part of this Agreement.

This Agreement may be executed in one or more counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original, but all of which together shall constitute one and the same instrument. Nothing herein contained shall be deemed to create or establish an employment, agency, joint venture, or partnership relationship between the Parties or any of their agents or employees, or any other legal arrangement that would impose liability upon one Party for the act or failure to act of the other Party. Neither Party shall have any express or implied power to enter into any contracts, commitments or negotiations or to incur any liabilities in the name of, or on behalf of, the other Party, or to bind the other Party in any respect whatsoever.
